item.description: US President Donald Trump is trying to increase economic pressure on Iran, but Tehran is unlikely to make a deal without a significant compromise. Iran's government has shown no signs of backing down from its nuclear program.

item.description: US priority in Project Freedom is a safe path through Hormuz, according to CENTCOM spokesman Tim Hawkins. US CENTCOM spokesman Tim Hawkins says the main priorities in Hormuz are securing safe routes & blockading Iran.

item.title: Before Vatican trip, Rubio defends Trump remarks on Pope Leo over Iran
item.description: US Senator Marco Rubio defended Trump's remarks on Pope Leo XIII's views on Iran before meeting Pope Francis at the Vatican. Rubio's comments come amid strained relations between the US and Iran.

item.title: U.S. says it's made Hormuz safe for commercial shipping, but standoff hasn't changed
item.description: The US announced a new military strategy to secure the Strait of Hormuz for commercial shipping. The administration has announced a new military strategy designed to open up the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, but it's unclear if this will break Iran's grip on the key waterway.

item.description: The US plans to raise tariffs on EU cars to 25%, impacting the luxury market. This move is a response to the EU's non-compliance with a trade deal that previously set tariffs at 15%.

item.title: Sudan recalls Ethiopia ambassador after strikes on Khartoum
item.description: Sudan has recalled its ambassador to Addis Ababa, accusing Ethiopia of being behind attacks on Khartoum's airport. The move comes amid escalating tensions between the two countries. Sudan has recalled its ambassador to Addis Ababa, accusing Ethiopia of being behind attacks on Khartoum’s airport.

item.title: US affirms ceasefire with Iran is still in effect despite rising tensions in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US has reaffirmed that its ceasefire with Iran remains in effect despite rising tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. The statement comes as the situation in the region remains volatile.

item.title: US Seeks Support Via the UN to Break Iran’s Hormuz Chokehold
item.description: The US is seeking support from the UN to address Iran's control over the Strait of Hormuz. The move aims to ease congestion and ensure safe passage for international shipping.

item.title: Will tensions escalate in the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: The US has proposed a plan to clear congestion in the Strait of Hormuz, dubbed "Project Freedom." The initiative aims to ease shipping traffic but its potential impact on regional tensions remains unclear.
